verdict.rationale: DBOS's Conductor dashboard lets teams monitor, pause, restart, fork and replay workflows and restart from a specific step, implying some step-level visibility (dbos-docs-16, dbos-docs-21), and self-hosting of the console/Conductor is documented (dbos-docs-19). However, the evidence never shows explicit per-step input/output/error display or a searchable/filterable UI, and community feedback flags that the observability UI historically wasn't self-hostable and isn't fully open-source (dbos-comm-8, dbos-comm-11). missing for 10: explicit documentation of per-step input/output/error fields in the dashboard, and evidence of search/filter functionality across runs.
